leaf_route_exemption.rationale: This sharded route catalog bounds its leaf routes by limits.route_parts (max_parts x routes_per_part, with warning and rollover bands and a declared remedy); a manifest count beside it duplicated that bound with neither.

cardinality_exemption.rationale: The surface registry removed this dimension under ADR 0045. The contract carried a second copy of the same bound, and one field held by two surfaces is how they come to disagree.

migration_metadata.reason: Contain the root before it warns. It stood at 222,294 of the 278,528-byte task_evidence ceiling (79.8%, the 80% warning one leaf away) after 38 leaves in two days, and its slices cost 2-5 KB each, so it would have crossed the 90% rollover within a working day. Boundaries are the file's own section and node boundaries: no line is rewritten and every region is a contiguous slice.
